2608.10176.title: TRACE: Trustworthy Retrieval-Augmented Conversational Engine
2608.10176.paper_summary: Public service chatbots are expected to deliver recommendations from an underlying public service directory, while also making sure that the recommendations respect explicit user constraints. In practice, public service directories are noisy and inconsistent, and general-purpose large language model (LLM) or AI-based chatbots frequently generate unreliable recommendations, citing unverified sources from the web. We investigate the impact of retrieval quality on constraint-aware recommendation in public service conversational systems built over noisy and heterogeneous service directories. We propose TRACE (Trustworthy Retrieval-Augmented Conversational Engine), a retrieval-based, constraint-aware framework that parses input user queries into structural and semantic constraints for downstream retrieval, with the help of a dual data representation schema. Using a curated statewide pantry directory and a synthetic query benchmark, we evaluate multiple knowledge-representation variants with and without knowledge graphs (KGs). We experiment with several open-source LLMs and a proprietary model, showing that strengthening retrieval substantially improves user constraint satisfaction while reducing hallucinated recommendations. Performance differences across LLMs narrowed in our experiments as retrieval quality improved, making results less sensitive to model size. These findings suggest that the quality of retrieval is key for robust public service conversational systems.
2608.10176.paper_summary_zh: 公共服務聊天機器人預期能夠從基礎的公共服務目錄中提供建議，同時確保這些建議尊重明確的用戶限制。實際上，公共服務目錄存在噪音和不一致的問題，而通用的大型語言模型（LLM）或基於人工智慧的聊天機器人經常生成不可靠的建議，引用來自網路的未經驗證的來源。我們研究了檢索質量對於基於約束的推薦在建立於噪音和異質服務目錄上的公共服務對話系統中的影響。我們提出了TRACE（可信檢索增強對話引擎），這是一個基於檢索的、考慮約束的框架，能夠將用戶輸入的查詢解析為結構性和語義性約束，以便進行下游檢索，並借助雙重數據表示架構。使用經過策劃的全州食品儲藏室目錄和合成查詢基準，我們評估了多個知識表示變體，包括有無知識圖（KGs）的情況。我們實驗了幾個開源的LLMs和一個專有模型，顯示加強檢索能顯著提高用戶約束滿意度，同時減少幻覺建議。在我們的實驗中，隨著檢索質量的提高，不同LLMs之間的性能差異縮小，使得結果對模型大小的敏感性降低。這些發現表明，檢索質量對於穩健的公共服務對話系統至關重要。
